text: Hey, does anyone know where to find the Partner FAQ for Selling with GitLab, specifically the bit about Purchase Orders? I’m trying to clarify what’s actually required for order acceptance and booking.

Yeah, Tom, for PO requirements there’s an Order Requirements Checklist in the Sales Order Processing handbook. It’s got all the details for booking an opportunity. I usually just check that doc to make sure everything’s covered.
Thanks, Mei! And if a partner wants to submit a signed GitLab quote instead of a PO, is that okay?
Yep, a signed GitLab quote or order form is fine instead of a PO, as long as it has the signature, full name, title, and date. Just double check it meets the booking requirements in the handbook.
Super helpful, Mei, thanks for jumping in! I always forget where that checklist lives.
